concept: Rooftop crate year above a music rehearsal loft
creativeDirection: Photorealistic daylight location photography of a rooftop rehearsal loft, using large physical "2021" digits built from vinyl crates as the lead subject and translating the album-cover motifs into real studio objects, painted surfaces, and carefully staged portraits.
scene: A wide 16:9 view into and across the roof terrace of a converted industrial music rehearsal space, seen from a slightly elevated neighboring rooftop so the giant digits read clearly while the loft interior and terrace details spread around them.

elements.element: the man from reference image 1 staged as a large centered chest-up portrait visible through a loft window, preserving his forward pose, closed eyes, glasses, bare shoulders, and vivid red background with blue light on his skin
a large painted sunburst mural on a rooftop wall: yellow radiating spikes on red with a blue center and two black oval eye-like forms
the terrace floor and a wall panel carry a smooth red-to-orange gradient field with faint dark stencil-like marks near the top edge

the two men from reference image 4 appear once together in a close black-and-white portrait on a freestanding rehearsal-room backdrop just inside the loft, preserving their tight framing and direct camera presence
the young man from reference image 5 appears once in a pale blue-framed black-and-white inset-style portrait mounted beside a pillar, preserving his turned-back pose and bare shoulders
a delicate translucent yellow mesh ribbon hangs diagonally between roof posts above the terrace
blue, turquoise, copper, and gold painterly swirls become a glossy tarpaulin draped over equipment cases and a section of roof surface

a cutaway caravan parked on the terrace edge, packed with the eclectic interior details: chandelier, fireplace, red chair, the seated person hidden behind a newspaper, Dalmatian, tree, telephone with lizard, and other curios

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait of one bare-shouldered man shown from the chest up against a vivid red background. His skin is lit in bright blue, creating a strong red-blue contrast. He has shoulder-length dark hair, closed eyes, light facial stubble, and dark rectangular glasses. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the figure facing forward.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: blue-lit portrait of a man with closed eyes and glasses
coverSummaries.people: one man facing forward with closed eyes, shoulder-length dark hair, glasses, and bare shoulders

coverSummaries.description: A bold abstract graphic on a red background featuring a large yellow sunburst-like shape with irregular radiating spikes. At the center is a rough blue oval containing two white outlined black oval forms that resemble eyes or openings. The image has a distressed, screen-printed look with thick flat colors.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: yellow sunburst with a blue face-like center and two black oval eyes

coverSummaries.description: A minimal cover filled almost entirely by a smooth red-to-orange gradient field. Near the top center is a faint row of dark geometric stencil-like marks. The composition is sparse and flat, with no figures or objects besides the subtle marks.

A black-and-white close portrait of two young men filling most of the frame. One is on the left, slightly forward, with dark styled hair and an earring, wearing a dark zippered jacket. The other is on the right with curly dark hair and a knit sweater, facing the camera. The background is plain and softly lit, and the composition is tightly cropped around their faces and shoulders.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: close black-and-white portrait of two men
coverSummaries.people: two young men in a close portrait, one with styled dark hair and earring, one with curly hair and a knit sweater

coverSummaries.description: A pale blue cover with a centered black-and-white rectangular photograph. The photo shows one young man in profile or three-quarter back view, bare-shouldered, turning his head toward the camera beside a vertical wall or pillar. The layout uses large flat color areas around the inset image, with a horizontal pale band crossing the lower part of the photo.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: black-and-white inset portrait of a bare-shouldered young man turning back
coverSummaries.medium: graphic layout with inset black-and-white photograph
coverSummaries.people: one young man shown bare-shouldered, turned partly away and looking back

coverSummaries.description: A very minimal white cover with a delicate yellow mesh or net-like form floating diagonally across the center. The shape is airy and translucent, made of many fine intersecting lines, tapering at both ends like a drifting fabric or wireframe ribbon. Large empty white space surrounds it.

An abstract cover divided visually into cool and warm zones, with sweeping painterly textures. The upper area is dominated by turquoise, cyan, and deep blue brush-like swirls, while the lower area glows with copper, gold, amber, and black. The composition feels glossy and layered, with broad gestural streaks and reflective surfaces.
coverSummaries.medium: abstract painting or manipulated painterly image

coverSummaries.album: The Very Very Best Of Crowded House
coverSummaries.description: A whimsical illustrated cutaway caravan or trailer interior packed with objects. Inside are patterned wallpaper, a chandelier, a fireplace with flames, a red upholstered chair, a person seated behind an open newspaper, and a Dalmatian dog beside the chair. Other visible items include a large tree growing through the room, autumn leaves, a cuckoo clock, framed pictures, a ladder, stacked chairs, a dress form, a pineapple, a red rotary telephone with a green lizard on it, a television, toy soldiers, a sailboat model, planets hanging near a window, buildings, a cake, and scattered leaves. The trailer sits on a single visible wheel above black grass silhouettes, with a warm sunset sky around it.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: surreal cutaway caravan interior filled with eclectic objects
coverSummaries.people: one person seated in a red chair with face hidden behind an open newspaper

prompt: Huge physical digits "2021" built from stacked vinyl crates dominate the center and upper half of the frame on a sunlit industrial rooftop terrace, viewed from a slightly elevated neighboring roof so the numbers read flat and legible across at least half the image width; behind and around the digits sits a converted rehearsal loft with open windows and terrace details. The primary subject is the crate-built "2021", each number crisp, solid, and physically plausible, with the music-world setting arranged to support it without competing. Through one large loft window, the man from reference image 1 appears as a chest-up studio portrait inside the room, preserving his centered forward pose, closed eyes, shoulder-length dark hair, glasses, bare shoulders, vivid red background, and bright blue light on his skin; inside another area of the loft, the two men from reference image 4 appear once together on a close black-and-white studio backdrop, preserving their tight portrait framing; beside a vertical pillar, the young man from reference image 5 appears once in a pale blue-framed black-and-white inset-style portrait, preserving his turned-back pose. On a rooftop wall, paint a bold mural from reference image 2: yellow sunburst spikes on red with a blue center and two black oval eye-like forms. Translate reference image 3 into a smooth red-to-orange gradient painted across part of the terrace floor and a wall panel, with faint dark stencil-like marks near the top. Suspend the delicate yellow mesh ribbon from reference image 6 diagonally between roof posts. Use the blue-and-copper swirls from reference image 7 as a glossy tarp draped over equipment cases and roof surfaces. Park the surreal cutaway caravan from reference image 8 at the terrace edge, its interior visible and packed with chandelier, fireplace, red upholstered chair, the seated person hidden behind an open newspaper, Dalmatian, tree, cuckoo clock, telephone with lizard, model sailboat, hanging planets, and scattered objects. Photorealistic location photography, clean and crisp, deep enough focus for the year and supporting motifs to read clearly. Bright early morning sunlight enters from the side and through loft windows, giving clear shadows and saturated color without harsh midday overhead light. Palette of saturated reds and blues with yellow accents, pale blue, white, black, and copper-gold notes; celebratory, inventive, and airy. The year "2021" appears exactly once as vinyl-crate digits on rooftop, built into the scene and lit like the rest of the photograph. It is the dominant subject and the first thing the eye reads: the digits span at least half the width of the frame, sit high or centred rather than along the bottom edge, and read face-on and legibly at thumbnail size, with the album motifs and people arranged around it. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one man facing forward with closed eyes, shoulder-length dark hair, glasses, and bare shoulders; reference image 4 shows two young men in a close portrait, one with styled dark hair and earring, one with curly hair and a knit sweater; reference image 5 shows one young man shown bare-shouldered, turned partly away and looking back; reference image 8 shows one person seated in a red chair with face hidden behind an open newspaper. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. The only lettering anywhere in the image is the year "2021": those four digits, spelled exactly 2 0 2 1, appearing once, large and legible, as a physical part of the scene rather than an overlay. Include no other readable text or lettering of any kind: no other words, letters, numbers, dates, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
